captions.detailed: A video astronomy tracking telescope with a short, wide Newtonian optical tube assembly in light grey, held by two black mounting rings. The assembly is supported by a black, motorized single-arm alt-azimuth mount with a rectangular drive base. The entire telescope setup is mounted on a three-legged grey tripod with a black circular connector hub. The telescope tube can rotate vertically along an altitude axis, while the entire mount arm rotates horizontally on a continuous azimuth axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a video astronomy tracking telescope with a short, wide cylindrical optical tube assembly on a motorized single-arm alt-az mount. The telescope should be supported by a simple three-legged tripod, with the optical tube clamped in dual mounting rings.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope using primitive cylinders and boxes. Create the tripod legs by instantiating three rotated cylinder shapes extending downwards from a central hub disk. Build the motorized mount base using a box primitive and the single-arm using an offset block. Model the telescope tube as a hollowed cylinder or a simple solid cylinder with contrasting colors, secured by two thin, large-radius rings. Define the relative positions and orientations using local coordinate transforms before converting the CadQuery shapes into mesh visuals.
